summary: This directory centralizes the service layer responsible for managing milestone lifecycles, including the creation, verification, polling, and retrieval of milestone definitions within the system.
responsibilities: Monitor milestone status through polling mechanisms
Retrieve and manage milestone definition data
relationships: The service layer orchestrates interactions with milestone definitions to facilitate tracking and state management.
Polling mechanisms rely on existing milestone definitions to verify and update the current status of tracked items.
designDecisions: Centralization of milestone operations within a dedicated service layer
Separation of concerns by isolating milestone management logic from business process execution
